claim: The one idea underneath: every key is a seven-note window sliding along the line of fifths — and 'each step darker lowers exactly one note.'

pieces.what: A walk up to the decoder ring: the line of fifths alone, then a seven-note window on it, then the tonic moved inside the window one step darker at a time, the single lowered note sounded each time. Tests 'exactly one note' by ear before the reader meets the full ring.
pieces.walks_up_from: the line of fifths as a strip of named notes

pieces.what: The explorer itself, gathered, opened on the guided moment for modal interchange.
Loudon's original Illustrator board beside the rebuild, the limits he named marked on the old one.
